name: Logarithmic Depth Partitioning
definition: A depth partitioning scheme that enforces a minimum angle resolution for surface normals by using logarithmic spacing, keeping cell extent ratios and minimum angle alpha constant throughout the perspective grid.
summary: Logarithmic Depth Partitioning is a voxelization scheme that uses logarithmic spacing to maintain constant minimum angle resolution, ensuring continuous surface appearance by allocating more depth precision near the camera than far away.
